scope: Acid availability boundary and Saibaman 2 / Crystal Raid provenance

records.name: Acid
evidence: The existing research record identifies Acid as a non-CaC Saibaman-type attack and records no normal player acquisition route.
Current accessible Xenoverse 2 community documentation identifies Acid as an exclusive Saibaman boss/Crystal Raid skill; the documented Saibaman 2 Crystal Raid preset includes Acid.
Dragon Ball reference material describes Acid as a Saibaman technique and distinguishes it from Poison and Saibabeam.
The current repository gap remains specifically the numeric Ki cost; no defensible current numeric cost was found in the evidence reviewed for this batch.

promoted_fields.unlock_method: Character/Crystal Raid use only; no normal Future Warrior acquisition route established

limits: No numeric Ki cost is promoted.
No normal shop, PQ, mentor, wish, raid-reward, or DLC acquisition route is inferred.
The evidence does not establish a universal player-selectable CaC route; Acid remains non-CaC in the repository's current taxonomy.
Exact projectile damage, debuff duration, frame data, and version-specific balance values are not promoted.

evidence_boundary: Batch 333 closes the availability/provenance ambiguity around Acid enough to distinguish its Crystal Raid/Saibaman use from normal CaC acquisition, but deliberately leaves the unresolved numeric Ki cost and detailed combat values untouched.
